issuingAuthority: Montana Office of the Court Administrator (Montana Judicial Branch)
draftingProhibitedBecause: Official Office of the Court Administrator form published as part of the MMRTA form set. The adopted packet instruction directs that the official form set is the product; a drafted substitute would displace a controlling official form.
blockingStatement: Master Library Edition 1.1 gives the OCA MMRTA Proposed Order and the OCA MMRTA Certificate of Service the same document ID, MT-OCA-MMRTA, distinguished only by document role, ORDER against SERVICE. They are two different binaries with two different SHA-256 values, so a component naming MT-OCA-MMRTA matches two retained assets carrying conflicting hashes and the authority gate records an authority hash conflict. No field map exists either.
owningLane: lane-D/E official-source identity and field-map acquisition — Master Library successor edition must assign this form its own document ID; registry implementationQueue: F_source_problem

serviceRecipientRecorded: The county attorney for the county in which the petition is filed. The county in question comes from the participant's answer to “Which county will you file in? The county attorney for that county must be served.” No county attorney office, address or name is asserted anywhere in this route.
